name: Investor Residence Permit (Third-Country National)

requirements.blocker_text: Invest at least EUR 500,000 in a new business still to be created in Luxembourg, creating at least 5 jobs within 3 years, coordinated through ADEM.
Invest at least EUR 500,000 in an existing company registered in Luxembourg, maintaining the investment and employment levels for at least 5 years.
Invest at least EUR 3,000,000 in a management and investment structure (existing or to be created), maintaining appropriate substance in Luxembourg.
Deposit at least EUR 20,000,000 with a financial institution established in Luxembourg, retained for a minimum of 5 years.

evidence_required.document: Investment project opinion from the Ministry of Finance
Proof of funds and investment/deposit records

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years, renewable; long-term resident status available after 5 years

sources.title: Guichet.lu -- Conditions of Residence for Investors from Third Countries: EUR 500,000 new-business/existing-company routes, EUR 3,000,000 management-structure route, EUR 20,000,000 financial-deposit route, all requiring Ministry of Finance opinion

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Luxembourg). Among the highest and most precisely tier-1-documented investor thresholds in this dataset -- all 4 routes explicitly figured, sourced directly from the government portal, no conflicting secondary figures. No citizenship-by-investment fast-track exists; investors follow the same lu_naturalisation.json/lu_permanent_residence.json timelines as any other resident.
